mechanism_narrative: The collapse in TRANSIT station usage from -23.7 to -67.3 percent removes the commuting and non-essential-trip backbone that feeds retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC keeps falling for at least four more weeks before any floor forms.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell 43.6 points between t-3w and t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the last-28-day mean of approximately -31.9 while TRANSIT remains below -55 in the following two weekly prints.

mechanism_narrative: Once RESIDENTIAL stays above +35 percent for a full week, home confinement has saturated and marginal households resume short discretionary errands, lifting RETAIL_REC above its crash-week trough within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean exceeds +35 percent for one consecutive week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from +12.4 at t-3w to +38.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC prints at or below -60.4 in both of the two weeks following a RESIDENTIAL reading above +35.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM holding near baseline while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES collapse shows the retail contraction is mandated closure rather than lost demand, so RETAIL_REC stays deeply negative as long as essential-trip volumes remain ring-fenced.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell only 19.8 points from t-3w while TRANSIT fell 43.6
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -40 for two consecutive weeks while GROCERY_PHARM remains more than 15 points above TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: The PARKS series falling 36.6 points to -48.9 shows outdoor discretionary outings are being suppressed alongside retail, so under a continuing stay-at-home regime the same trip-suppression channel drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next month.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 15 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS dropped 18.3 points between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS recovers above -25 within two weeks while RETAIL_REC continues to print below -55 for the rest of the 28-day window.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES down 63.1 percent removes the weekday commuter and after-work customer base that anchors urban retail in Greater London, so retail footfall cannot recover until workplace presence stabilises, keeping RETAIL_REC below its trailing mean.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -11.3 to -63.1 across the four weekly means
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than -31.1 while WORKPLACES remains below -55.

mechanism_narrative: If the week-on-week deterioration in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES flattens to less than 5 points, containment is at its strictest point and the marginal re-opening of small retail formats produces a partial RETAIL_REC rebound within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: week-on-week change in TRANSIT is smaller than 5 points in absolute value
failure_condition: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both keep deteriorating by more than 10 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC stays below -55 throughout the 28-day window.

mechanism_narrative: The one-week reversal of GROCERY_PHARM from +0.7 to -19.1 marks the end of the stockpiling surge, so the extra grocery trips that padded total trip counts disappear and pull aggregate out-of-home activity lower within the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses below -15 percent in a weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from +0.7 at t-1w to -19.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the week following a GROCERY_PHARM print below -15 is higher than the -60.4 reading at t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: The joint acceleration of RESIDENTIAL upward and RETAIL_REC downward amplifies trip suppression: each additional point of residential time is matched by a larger retail decline, so the interaction keeps RETAIL_REC below the trailing mean for four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose 16.6 points while RETAIL_REC fell 29.3 points between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves by more than 15 points from -60.4 within four weeks while RESIDENTIAL remains above +35.
